{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high, especially in early horizons, showing clear mean-reversion bias that corrects toward mean as prediction horizon extends",
    "Sentiment signals have delayed and dampened impact on forecasts, with positive sentiment failing to generate commensurate price increases",
    "Price momentum in the history is substantially understated in forecasts, particularly at shorter lookback periods",
    "Volatility is poorly captured, with forecasts being overly smooth relative to true outcome fluctuations",
    "Sentiment divergence from price movement indicates the model over-weights sentiment indicators relative to actual price dynamics",
    "Forecast lag increases with prediction horizon as prices mean-revert toward model-initialized levels",
    "Sentiment amplification effects are absent in forecasts despite resembling patterns in true outcomes"
] }
